string.text: Other Mods
Pike Blow Magnitude
Multiplier for blow magnitude of pikes. Default is 2.
Minimum Pikemen in Pike Formation
Minimum percentage of pikemen in a formation to be treated as a pike formation. Default is 50%.
Maximum Distance to Ready Pikes
Maximum distance to nearby enemies for pikemen to ready their pikes. Default is 50m.
Pikemen Can Block
Pikemen can block with their pikes (unrealistic). Disabled by default.
Pikemen Can Attack Overhead
Pikemen can perform overhead attacks (unrealistic). Disabled by default.
Pikemen Can Turn Sideways
Pikemen can turn sideways when in pike formation. Disabled by default.
Pikes Have Collision
Pikes can obstruct enemies who try to get past the pike head. Enabled by default.
Pikemen Can Panic from Cavalry Charges
Pikemen can panic from cavalry charges (a feature from RBM). Disabled by default.
Pikemen Can Kick and Bash
Pikemen can kick and bash (a feature from RBM). Disabled by default.
Pikemen Can Perform Cinematic Combat Actions
Pikemen can perform matched combat actions, kill moves and master strikes (a feature from Artem's Cinematic Combat). Disabled by default.
Pikemen Can Perform Cinematic Charges
Pikemen can perform cinematic charges (a feature from Artem's Cinematic Charges). Disabled by default.
